user.title: Ilmy services, location and content
user.description:
No account is needed: prayer times are computed locally on this device, and the Ilmy services are queried anonymously once per day (Hijri date, hadith and verse of the day).

The default service URLs work for most users. Custom (e.g. self-hosted) hosts receive the same anonymous daily queries — https:// is required unless the host is localhost or a private (LAN) address.

data_description.hijri_url: https:// required (http only for localhost/private hosts)
data_description.hadith_url: https:// required (http only for localhost/private hosts)
data_description.quran_url: https:// required (http only for localhost/private hosts)
data_description.hadith_book: Collection used for the hadith of the day

prayer_time.name: Prayer time
prayer_time.description: Triggers at a computed prayer time (fajr, sunrise, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha or midnight), with an optional offset — use a negative duration to trigger before the prayer (e.g. 10 minutes before Maghrib).

prayer.name: Prayer
prayer.description: The prayer time to trigger on, or "Any prayer" for each prayer time.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: How long after (or, when negative, before) the prayer time to trigger.
